answer: Concretely, price identity before it can speak. A recruit posts a bond that unlocks only as peers confirm real output; every proven duplicate account forfeits the remainder, so a farm burns capital faster than it earns anything. In effect the saffron of free entry disappears, the quartz of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the raven case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Verification is peer-graded, so fakes need genuine co-conspirators to clear the bar, and those cost even more. Honest single accounts stay cheap, which is the whole point.
